subject: Acme SIG: inventory and dataflow confirmations for telemetry & support vendors
messages:
From: Alice Turner <alice.turner@acmehealth.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-29 09:02 -0800
Subject: SIG follow-up — telemetry & support vendor confirmations

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our compliance team is preparing the SIG intake and has asked for a concise list of Redwood's subprocessors focused on telemetry/observability and support tooling (what vendors collect telemetry, retention windows, and a short note on whether they can be excluded from production access). In particular Acme needs: 

- List of vendors that receive logs/metrics/traces from customer workloads (hostnames or service names are fine).
- What telemetry is forwarded to each vendor (logs, metrics, traces, error reports).
- Retention period defaults and any configurable options.
- Whether vendor employees ever have production data access (and if so, controls).

I've attached our standard evidence request (acme_evidence_request_2026-11-29.pdf) with deadlines for the SIG intake (Dec 7). Would Redwood be able to provide a short inventory + any supporting attestations? If possible, a simple CSV is perfect.

Appreciate it — Alice
Director, Vendor Risk
Acme Health
From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Turner <alice.turner@acmehealth.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-29 11:28 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up — telemetry & support vendor confirmations

Hi Alice,

Thanks for the clear ask and the deadline. We're on it — I can deliver an initial inventory and short notes by EOD Monday (Nov 30) and follow up with supporting artifacts (attestations/network diagram) early next week. High level plan: 

1) Karthik will pull the current subprocessor inventory and mark telemetry categories per vendor.
2) Lauren will check retention settings across telemetry sinks and whether prod access is permitted.
3) I'll stitch into the CSV and attach any existing vendor SOC/SIG assertions.

Two quick clarifying Qs: 
- Do you need a network-level dataflow diagram (internal -> vendor) or is a table mapping services to vendor endpoints enough?
- For retention, do you need absolute retention values or buckets (30/90/365+ days)?

We should be able to hit the Dec 7 intake comfortably. Attaching an initial extractor CSV (redwood_subprocessors_v1.csv) to speed review.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_subprocessors_v1.csv (CSV stub: vendor,service,telemetry_types,prod_access,default_retention)
From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Alice Turner <alice.turner@acmehealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-30 08:14 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up — telemetry & support vendor confirmations

Hi Alice / team,

Quick answers to Vanessa's questions: 
- A table mapping services to vendor endpoints + a small network sketch should be sufficient for Acme's initial intake. I'll include a PNG sketch (network-dataflow-sketch.png) that shows where logs/metrics/traces leave our environment.
- For retention we can provide specific values where configured. For managed services some defaults are 30d logs, 90d traces, 365d metrics (we will call out exceptions).

Status update: 
- Datadog: receives metrics + logs + traces for hosted customers using our optional observability integration; production access is limited to SREs under role-based controls and covered by our access policy.
- AWS (CloudWatch/S3 for backups): stores certain artifacts; no vendor support staff access to customer plaintext data; retention configurable per bucket.
- Sentry: error reports only for customers who opt-in; retention default 30 days, option to extend.

I'll build out these rows in the CSV and add direct links to vendor attestations where available.

Lauren Bishop
Security & Trust (internal liaison)
Redwood Inference

Attachment: network-dataflow-sketch.png (diagram stub)
From: Ingrid Moss <ingrid@datadog.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-30 13:03 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up — Datadog details

Hi Lauren / Vanessa,

Thanks for looping me in. A couple of clarifications from Datadog side for the inventory: 

- Telemetry types received: metrics, application logs, APM traces (we do not receive customer PII unless explicitly forwarded in logs).
- Default retention: metrics 365 days (aggregated), traces 90 days, logs 30 days. We offer configurable retention via account settings.
- Access: Datadog employee access to customer accounts is scoped to support cases and requires explicit customer authorization; we provide audit logs and can provide a signed statement for your SIG packet.

I'll attach our standard attestation PDF if you want a vendor-signed artifact — let me know where to send it.

Best,
Ingrid Moss
Enterprise Sales Engineer
Datadog
From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Turner <alice.turner@acmehealth.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, markus_klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-01 15:17 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up — telemetry & support vendor confirmations

Alice,

Attached is our compiled CSV and a short checklist for Acme's SIG intake (sig-evidence-checklist-vanessa.xlsx). Highlights: 

- Attached CSV (redwood_subprocessors_v1.csv) includes vendor, telemetry types, default retention, whether employees can access prod data, and pointer to vendor attestations.
- Network sketch (network-dataflow-sketch.png) shows the three egress paths to Datadog, Sentry, and AWS logging buckets.
- We requested vendor-signed attestations from Datadog and will add them to the Drive link once received.

If Acme needs any stronger contractual language (e.g., explicit prohibition of vendor support access or HIPAA BAAs), flag that and I will route to our legal team for a short amendment.

Next steps: 
- Alice: confirm if you want us to redact any non-essential internal hostnames before sharing publicly.
- Karthik/Markus: prepare any additional audit logs requested by Acme (we can pull request logs for last 90 days).

Thanks all — happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
